briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind escalate multi-agent AGI benchmarks amid rising safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as frontier labs release advanced reasoning models while regulatory scrutiny grows. Compute constraints and prompt injection vulnerabilities dominate discussions across industry and government.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4-preview with enhanced multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus leads on safety benchmarks while Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced $15B expansion of its Texas AI supercluster. NVIDIA's Blackwell ramp reaches 500K units shipped with TSMC reporting record 3nm yields.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will a single lab achieve verifiable AGI alignment before 2028 or will fragmented open-source efforts outpace closed safety models?
